connector.name: Runapi MCP
connector.registryDescription: 130+ AI models for image, video, music, and audio - 18 model families, one RunAPI account.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.runapi.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the runapi-builder account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: RUNAPI_API_KEY
env.description: Optional RunAPI API key for headless hosts. Interactive MCP hosts can use the login tool, which writes shared RunAPI config.
